none: PAS NLM-12FB57: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valens from near Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Valens (364-378), Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALE[---]AVG. Reverse description: Emperor dragging captive right and holding labarum. Reverse inscription: [G]LORIA [ROMAN]ORVM. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.6mm, Weight: 2.23gms, die axis: 6
